VII, 18</cite>) <he>היה חופר בתוך ביתו כ׳ קטנה והיו מכוונים וכ׳</he> used to make in his house a small aperture which was directed exactly towards the east, so that when the morning star rose, he might rise and worship it; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>קטה כמין ניכו׳</he> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="K00252"><he>כּוֹכֶבֶת</he></cite>.
